title: Boy Swallows Scissors Unharmed
body: Yerushalayim's Shaare Zedek Medical Center staff stunned as 11-yr-old boy emerges unharmed after swallowing scissors, no surgery or injury required.

title: Yeshiva Student Detained at Home
body: Israeli military police arrested Yitzchak Rebibo, a talmid at Yeshivas Rabbeinu Chaim Ozer, at his home in Ramat Gan after a previous detention attempt was thwarted by mass protests.

title: Jewish Professor Slain at Home
body: A Jewish, pro-Israel MIT professor, Nuno F. Gomes Loureiro, 47, was killed in a shooting at his Brookline, Massachusetts residence. Authorities have confirmed the incident.
